child: Teach {member} how to do {activity}. Be a patient teacher!
adult: Teach {member} the basics of {activity}. Let them have a go.

child: Play {member} your favourite song and tell them why you love it.
adult: Play {member} a song that makes you happy and tell them why it matters to you.

child: Show {member} something you made or drew that you're proud of.
adult: Show {member} something you've made or done that you're proud of, and tell them the story behind it.

child: Take {member} to your favourite spot at home or in the garden and tell them why you like it.
adult: Take {member} to a place nearby that you love and tell them what it means to you.

child: Tell {member} 3 things that made you happy this week.
adult: Tell {member} three things that have made you happy lately – big or small.

child: Ask {member} to join you for 15 minutes of {activity}.
adult: Invite {member} to spend 20 minutes doing {activity} with you.

child: Show {member} your favourite game, video or book and explain what's great about it.
adult: Share your favourite film, book or show with {member} and talk about why you like it.

child: Tell {member} what you want to be or do when you're older.
adult: Tell {member} about something you'd love to do or learn in the next year.

child: Cook or make your favourite snack for {member}.
adult: Cook your favourite meal for {member} and tell them why it's your favourite.

child: Show {member} a photo of you when you were little and tell them about it.
adult: Show {member} a photo from your childhood and tell them a story from that time.

child: Make a 'me poster' with {member}: draw yourself and everything you love around you.
adult: Make a 'things that make me, me' list together with {member} – then swap and compare.

child: Teach {member} a dance move, joke or trick that only you know.
adult: Teach {member} a skill you have that they don't – a recipe, a trick, a tool.

child: Ask {member} to help you try something new you've wanted to do.
adult: Ask {member} to try something new with you that you've been wanting to do.

child: Make {member} a 'top 5' list of your favourite things and go through it together.
adult: Share your 'top 5' with {member}: songs, places, foods. Ask for theirs.

child: Tell {member} about something brave you did and how it felt.
adult: Tell {member} about a hard time you got through and what helped you.

child: Build or create something that shows who you are, then give it to {member}.
adult: Make something small by hand for {member} that reflects you – a card, a drawing, a jar of something.

child: Show {member} how you like to calm down, and do it together for 5 minutes.
adult: Show {member} what helps you relax and do it together for 10 minutes.

child: Make a playlist of 5 songs about you and listen to it with {member}.
adult: Make a short playlist that says something about you and listen to it with {member}.

child: Ask {member} to watch you do {activity} and cheer you on.
adult: Invite {member} to come along while you do {activity}.

child: Tell {member} one thing you're good at and show them.
adult: Tell {member} about a strength of yours and give them an example from this week.
